operationContracts.name: 查看工作区服务协议及 BAA 状态与说明
operationContracts.effect: Under account access, selected account, account-query and imported eligible-plan guards, read workspace agreements metadata. Always show the service-agreement link; show BAA only for the HIPAA workspace flag, including signed/timestamp state and external document/help links.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Loading, denied, account-query error and metadata error are distinct. Stale metadata may remain visible beside retry; signed falls back to timestamp only when signed is nullish. Invalid timestamp text is retained rather than invented.

operationContracts.name: 确认签署当前工作区 BAA
operationContracts.effect: For an unsigned HIPAA workspace, Agree posts /quorum/workspace/{account_id}/sign_baa using the selected workspace/account headers; success merges signed:true and returned timestamp, then invalidates the exact metadata query.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Pending disables the Agree control; failure displays the sign error and permits retry. The selected callback has no extra confirmation dialog. Signing is a legal/account service action, never a navigation effect.

operationContracts.name: 通过外部账户设置添加或更改邮件
operationContracts.effect: Query change-email eligibility for the selected user/account. When eligible, Add/Change routes to https://chatgpt.com/#settings/Account through the external-browser bridge. The selected root fixes auth0ClientId to null.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Because that client ID is null, this root disables the local reauth query and never mounts the local email/OTP modal. Retained dormant helpers are not additional reachable local email operations. Pending disables the visible action.

operationContracts.name: 确认永久删除个人账户
operationContracts.effect: Only a loaded personal account with matching user/account may open confirmation. Require recent token, subscription query loaded, exact trimmed keyword and case-insensitive contact match; recheck token on submit. POST /accounts/deactivate with acquired risk headers, then delegate logout/navigation.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Pending suppresses repeat submit. Close/unmount aborts refresh; stale-login errors clear fields and start refresh. Reauth validates user/account/nonce/age and password-auth time. Organization-managed and sole-business-owner errors remain distinct. This is account-wide service deletion, not local project/thread cleanup.
